expertise.title: Areas of Expertise
expertise.description: Maître Aurélie MANIER handles the following situations in particular:

items.litigation: Disputes in the context of an employment relationship or dismissal
items.organisms: Disputes with social organizations (Social Security, Pension Fund, Disabled Persons Office)

support.title: Personalized Support
support.paragraph1: The goal is to support you and help you find the procedure that best suits you.
support.paragraph2: There is no obligation to go to court; it is always worthwhile to attempt an amicable procedure first.
support.paragraph3: In the case of medical disputes against certain social organizations or even in the context of an employer-employee dispute, it is possible to seek the opinion of a consulting physician to give more weight to your requests and arguments.

consultations.title: Consultations
consultations.description: Maître MANIER receives you according to your personal preferences:

items.office: At the office located in the 3rd arrondissement of Lyon

items.fees: Fees discussed in advance and adapted to the client's financial situation
items.transparent: All steps of the procedure are reviewed with you to avoid bad surprises.

intro.content: This privacy policy aims to inform you about how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.content:
The data controller is Aurélie MANIER, Attorney at the Lyon Bar.

For any questions regarding your personal data, you can contact us:

collection.title: Data Collected
collection.intro: Depending on how you use the site, we collect the following data:

items.contactForm: Contact form: first name, last name, email address, phone (optional) and the content of your message, only if you send it
items.analytics: Anonymized analytical data (Umami Analytics): pages visited, visit duration, device used (without personal identification)

purpose.title: Processing Purposes
purpose.intro: This data is used for the following purposes:

items.contactForm: Answer requests sent through the contact form and, where relevant, arrange an appointment
items.analytics: Improve user experience on the site
items.stats: Analyze traffic and site usage anonymously

legal.title: Legal Basis
legal.content:
The processing of your data is based on:

Your consent: for messages sent through the contact form (checkbox). You can withdraw it at any time by writing to contact@aureliemanier-avocat.fr
Legitimate interest: for anonymous audience measurement, to improve the site and its content

recipients.title: Data Recipients
recipients.content:
Your personal data is intended only for Aurélie MANIER and is never sold or shared with third parties, except for legal obligations.

Contact form messages pass through the servers of our host, Alwaysdata (Paris, France), which acts as a processor and does not access them for its own purposes. They are not stored on the site: they are emailed directly to the office.

retention.title: Retention Period
retention.content:
Messages sent through the contact form are kept in the office's mailbox for a maximum of 3 years after the last exchange if they do not lead to a case; otherwise, they are kept with the case file for the period required by the rules of the legal profession.

Anonymized analytical data is kept for a maximum period of 13 months in accordance with CNIL recommendations.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.intro: In accordance with GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.access: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data
items.rectification: Right of rectification: correct your inaccurate or incomplete data
items.deletion: Right to erasure: request deletion of your data
items.opposition: Right to object: object to the processing of your data
items.portability: Right to portability: retrieve your data in a structured format
items.complaint: Right to lodge a complaint: file a complaint with the CNIL

rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, contact us at: contact@aureliemanier-avocat.fr

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement all appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against any loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration or destruction.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: Aurélie Manier wants everyone to be able to use this website and contact the office, whatever their disability or the way they browse. This statement applies to aureliemanier-avocat.fr.

status.title: Compliance status
status.content: The website has not yet been fully audited against the French accessibility standard (RGAA) by an external body. It is partially compliant: an internal review carried out on 31 October 2026 against the international WCAG 2.1 level AA guidelines found no remaining errors on the pages tested after fixes, but it does not cover every RGAA criterion.

items.keyboard: The whole website can be used with a keyboard; the selected element always has a visible outline, and a "Skip to main content" link bypasses the menu.
items.screenReader: Pages are structured with headings and regions (header, navigation, content, footer), images are described, and links that open a new window say so.
items.contrast: Text has sufficient contrast with its background.
items.zoom: Content stays readable, without horizontal scrolling, at up to 400% zoom or on a small screen.
items.motion: Animations are turned off when you have asked your system to reduce motion.
items.media: The website has no video or audio content; the office can be contacted in writing (email or post) as well as by phone.

items.map: The map on the Contact page is provided by OpenStreetMap and may be hard to use with a keyboard or a screen reader. The office address and a directions link are given as text next to it.
items.external: External websites linked from this one (OpenStreetMap, French National Bar Council, hosting provider) are not covered by this statement.

testing.title: How the website was checked
testing.content: Automated tests with the axe-core tool on every page, in French and English, on desktop and mobile; manual tests of keyboard navigation, focus visibility, zoom and text spacing in the Chromium browser. The website is built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

contact.title: Report a problem
contact.content: If you cannot access any content or service on this website, write to or call the office: we will reply and provide the information in another form.
